en.headline: Two more unattended dogs caught near Yuen Long attack site
en.dek: AFCD and police took two further dogs in a Tuesday night sweep around Pok Wai, the third large search in two days after a cyclist died.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said it and police caught two unattended mongrels on Tuesday night around Pok Wai South Road, Pok Wai West Road and Kam Pok Road in Yuen Long, the third large capture operation in two days after a 27-year-old woman died following a suspected dog attack while cycling in the area.

The department said the two dogs would be held at an animal management centre for observation. If a microchip is found, officers will contact the registered keeper to assist the investigation. Police have installed additional cameras at the scene and continue to lead the inquiry into the woman's death. The department has not confirmed that any of the captured animals were involved.

Three adult mongrels were taken in an earlier sweep on Monday. AFCD Assistant Director Ip Yin said two of those dogs had microchips and the department was contacting keepers using licence records, and would prosecute if keepers had failed their legal duties. The third dog had no chip. She said captured animals would be assessed; dogs found suitable could be offered for adoption through partner groups, while animals assessed as a serious public-safety risk could face humane dispatch.
The department advised people who meet unattended dogs in public to stay calm, keep a safe distance and report the location and the animal's appearance to 1823.

zh.headline: 元朗再捕兩隻無人看管唐狗 兩日內第三度行動
zh.dek: 漁護署與警方周二晚在壤圍一帶再捕捉兩隻無人看管唐狗，屬單車女子死亡事件後兩日內第三次大型搜捕。
body: 漁農自然護理署表示，署方聯同警方周二晚上在元朗壤圍南路、壤圍西路及錦壤路一帶，再捕捉兩隻無人看管的唐狗。這是一名27歲女子在該處踩單車後懷疑遭狗隻襲擊死亡以來，當局兩日內第三次大型捕捉行動。
漁護署指兩隻狗會送往動物管理中心扣留觀察；如發現晶片，會按登記資料聯絡畜養人協助調查。警方已在現場加裝攝錄鏡頭，並繼續主導死者死因調查。署方未有確認任何被捕捉狗隻與事件有關。
當局周一較早行動已捕捉三隻成年唐狗。漁護署助理署長葉彥表示，當中兩隻有晶片，署方正按牌照資料聯絡畜養人，若有證據顯示畜養人未履行法律責任會提出檢控；其餘一隻沒有晶片。她指署方會評估被捕捉狗隻的性情及健康，合適者可經伙伴機構安排領養，若評估屬嚴重公眾安全風險則或須考慮人道處理。
漁護署呼籲市民在公眾地方遇到無人看管狗隻時保持決靜，保持安全距離，並致電1823報告位置及狗隻外貌。
